title: Something above the ranch defies rockets and manipulates drones; anomalies below it
summary: Brandon Fugal tells of Something above the ranch defies rockets and manipulates drones; anomalies below it, about 2016-2020s at Skinwalker Ranch, Utah, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: We've documented an effect that there is something within the space above the ranch that defies rockets, that manipulates drones,

plain: Brandon Fugal, the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange happenings, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that since about 2016 his team has documented something in the space above the ranch that throws off rockets and interferes with drones, along with odd readings below the ground. He cites a Dr. Taylor, and if true, it would mean some unknown thing is physically present at the site and acting on machines.
